entries.originalText: When I consider Thy dignity, O Lord, and mine own vileness, I tremble very exceedingly, and am confounded within myself.
entries.modernizedText: When I consider Your dignity, O Lord, and my own vileness, I tremble exceedingly and am confounded within myself.

entries.originalText: For if I approach not, I fly from life; and if I intrude myself unworthily, I run into Thy displeasure.
entries.modernizedText: For if I do not approach, I flee from life; and if I intrude unworthily, I incur Your displeasure.

entries.originalText: What then shall I do, O my God, Thou helper and Counsellor in necessities.
entries.modernizedText: What then shall I do, O my God, my helper and Counselor in need?

entries.originalText: Teach Thou me the right way; propound unto me some short exercise befitting Holy Communion.
entries.modernizedText: Teach me the right way; set before me some short exercise fitting for Holy Communion.

entries.originalText: For it is profitable to know how I ought to prepare my heart devoutly and reverently for Thee, to the intent that I may receive Thy Sacrament to my soul’s health [or it may be also for the celebrating this so great and divine mystery].
entries.modernizedText: For it is profitable to know how I ought to prepare my heart devoutly and reverently for You, so that I may receive Your Sacrament for the health of my soul [or also for celebrating this great and divine mystery].
